title: •Commander Praji
caption: •Commander Praji (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. During your control phase (twice if aboard _Devastator_), may use 1 Force to ▲ an Imperial pilot of ability < 3.
lore: Vader’s aide on the _Devastator_. Personally supervised search for Death Star plans on Tatooine by Vader’s order. Was graduated with honors from Imperial Navy Academy on Carida.
